name: io.github.YoanWai/stremio-mcp
title: Stremio
description: MCP server for Stremio: search and browse content, manage the account library, install and order addons across every signed-in device, and control Stremio on a desktop or an Android TV.

environmentVariables.name: STREMIO_AUTH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Stremio account auth key. Enables the library and addon tools, including installing addons onto every signed-in device. The stremio_login tool can obtain and remember one instead.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_TV_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IP or hostname of the Android TV running Stremio. Needed only for the TV control tools.

environmentVariables.name: ANDROID_TV_PORT
environmentVariables.description: adb TCP port on the Android TV.

environmentVariables.name: STREMIO_MCP_ADDON_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the built-in subtitle addon serves on. Any free port works; the manifest URL carries the real one.

environmentVariables.name: STREMIO_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the cached login, subtitle files and addon backups live. Defaults to the platform user data directory.
